question: 2 pens and 3 pencils cost ₹35, and 3 pens and 2 pencils cost ₹40. Find the cost of 3 pencils.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Add both equations: (2 pens + 3 pencils) + (3 pens + 2 pencils)

= 5 pens + 5 pencils = 75

⇒ pen + pencil = 15

From first: 2p + 3c = 35 ⇒ substitute p = 15 − c

**∴ Answer = 15**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

2 pens + 3 pencils = 35, 3 pens + 2 pencils = 40

**Formula used:**

Solving linear equations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let cost of pen = x, pencil = y

⇒ 2x + 3y = 35 ...(1)

⇒ 3x + 2y = 40 ...(2)

⇒ Multiply (1) by 3 ⇒ 6x + 9y = 105

⇒ Multiply (2) by 2 ⇒ 6x + 4y = 80

⇒ Subtract ⇒ (6x + 9y) − (6x + 4y) = 105 − 80

⇒ 5y = 25

⇒ y = 5

⇒ Cost of 3 pencils = 3 × 5 = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equations

Two equations can be solved using substitution or elimination

Elimination Method

Make coefficients equal and subtract equations

Shortcut Insight

Add equations to reduce variables quickly

Substitution Method

Express one variable and substitute into another equation
